messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: finite projective plane PG(2,3) coordinates mapped affinely

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The affine image of PG(2,3) that maximizes the minimum triangle area maps the three points at infinity to (0,0), (1,0), and (0,1), placing the four affine points on each of the three lines through these infinity points at equally spaced positions (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1), yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/24. The optimality of this configuration within the PG(2,3) family follows because any non-uniform spacing along a line through infinity creates a collinear triple whose adjacent gap shrinks below 1/4, reducing the minimum area below 1/24."}
